notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Brought level count to 100 with the addition of 10 Brown Levels. It's listed as Brown in section select or after level 90.

Green 2 and White 2 changed to Pink and Orange.

Green 2 and White 2 Achievement icon and name change.

Added in 12 more Achievements to bring the total count to 26.

notes.title: 10 More Levels
notes.content:
Added in 10 additional levels. It's listed as White 2 in section selection or after level 80.

I pushed this update earlier today but had to roll it back because it messed up all of the achievements.

notes.title: Section Select
notes.content:
Added in a section select option so players can navigate to a specific color section. Green, White, Purple, Red, etc.

Added in confirmation to delete and reset data, just in case.
